demote.title: Demote to restricted user
demote.content: Are you sure you want to demote “{{email}}” to restricted user? They will lose access to all containers.

promote.title: Promote to administrator
promote.content: Are you sure you want to promote “{{email}}” to administrator? They will have access to all containers.

restrict.title: Deny all containers
restrict.content: Are you sure you want to restrict “{{email}}”? The user will no longer see any container.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.content: Are you sure you want to delete “{{email}}”? This action cannot be undone and will also delete their API keys.
